title: Sense Once, Serve Many: Common-Trace Factorized Constrained PPO for Online Sensing-Session Consolidation in Multi-Tenant ISAC Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.29256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) networks can serve compatible requests through shared sensing sessions, but consolidation couples admission, reuse, profile selection, sensing service-level agreements (SLAs), communication quality of service (QoS), and future commitments. We formulate this problem as a constrained Markov decision process and propose Common-Trace Factorized Constrained Proximal Policy Optimization (CT-PPO). During training, stochastic policy replicas share the same primitive workload trace; leave-one-out discounted Monte Carlo return contrasts provide reward credit to applicable actor factors, while constraint credit remains factor/prefix-specific. Across five training seeds and matched workloads, CT-PPO achieves the highest mean macro return, exceeding matched Joint-Credit PPO (JC-PPO) by 0.934 (95% confidence interval [0.702, 1.164]) and SLA-Aware Greedy by 1.847; versus JC-PPO, it reduces sensing-resource

translated_title: 一次感知，多方服务：面向多租户ISAC网络在线感知会话整合的公共轨迹因子化约束PPO
translated_abstract: 通感一体化（ISAC）网络可以通过共享感知会话来服务兼容的请求，但会话整合将准入控制、资源复用、配置选择、感知服务等级协议（SLA）、通信服务质量（QoS）以及未来承诺等多个方面耦合在一起。我们将该问题形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并提出公共轨迹因子化约束近端策略优化算法（CT-PPO）。在训练过程中，随机策略副本共享相同的原始工作负载轨迹；通过留一法折扣蒙特卡洛回报对比为适用的行动者因子提供奖励信用，而约束信用则保持因子/前缀特定。在五个训练种子和匹配的工作负载下，CT-PPO实现了最高的平均宏观回报，比匹配的联合信用PPO（JC-PPO）高出0.934（95%置信区间[0.702, 1.164]），比SLA感知贪心算法高出1.847；与JC-PPO相比，它降低了感知资源……
tldr: 该论文提出公共轨迹因子化约束近端策略优化算法（CT-PPO），通过共享轨迹和留一法回报对比机制，有效解决多租户ISAC网络中感知会话整合与准入控制等多目标耦合问题，实现了更高的宏观回报并降低感知资源消耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Common-Trace Factorized Constrained PPO (CT-PPO), which uses shared workload traces and leave-one-out Monte Carlo return contrasts to solve the coupled admission, reuse, and SLA/QoS constraints in online sensing-session consolidation for multi-tenant ISAC networks, achieving the highest macro return and reduced sensing-resource usage.
